name: reolink-cli
description: Plugin for operating Reolink cameras through the local CLI.

interface.longDescription: Operate cameras you own or are authorized to manage through the separately installed Reolink CLI and gateway. Discover devices, inspect settings, capture media, and control PTZ, lights, and audio. Requires local desktop execution and network access to the cameras; public binaries are LAN-only. Tool results and selected media may be processed by your AI provider.
defaultPrompt: Discover nearby Reolink cameras and tell me which host or UID to use.
Log in to my configured Reolink camera and summarize model, firmware, and capabilities.
Capture a preview or move PTZ on the configured camera.
